Garlic-Butter Steak Bites & Potatoes

A hearty meal-prep tray of seared steak bites, golden potatoes and garlicky butter, inspired by the Reel’s steak-and-potato combo.

Prep
Not listed
Cook
Not listed
Total
35 min
Difficulty
Not listed
Ingredients
9

Ingredients

  • 2 lb (900 g) lean sirloin steak, cut into 1-inch cubes
  • 1½ lb (680 g) baby potatoes, quartered
  • 1 tbsp olive oil, divided
  • 2 tbsp butter
  • 3 cloves garlic, finely chopped
  • 1 tsp smoked paprika
  • ½ tsp dried thyme
  • Salt and black pepper
  • Chopped parsley, to finish

Amounts are scaled from 4 original servings. Season to taste.

Instructions

  1. Heat oven to 400°F (200°C). Toss potatoes with half the olive oil, paprika, thyme, salt and pepper. Spread on a sheet pan and roast 25–30 minutes, turning once, until browned and tender.
  2. Pat steak dry and season generously with salt and pepper. Heat the remaining oil in a large skillet over high heat.
  3. Sear steak in a single layer, working in batches if needed, for about 2 minutes per side for browned edges and a medium center.
  4. Lower heat. Add butter and garlic; stir for 30 seconds, then toss the steak through the garlic butter.
  5. Divide potatoes and steak among four meal-prep containers. Spoon any pan butter over the top and finish with parsley.

Cook times may vary when changing batch size.
